cases.question: Which seasons had at least a dozen episodes? Give me the season and number of episodes, busiest seasons first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(*) FROM episodes GROUP BY season HAVING COUNT(*) >= 12 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, season ASC

cases.question: Between the start of 2005 and the end of 2010, which seasons had at least 8 episodes? Show the episode count for each, highest first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(*) FROM episodes WHERE air_date BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' GROUP BY season HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, season ASC

cases.question: How many episodes belong to seasons 4 through 8 and aired in 2007 or later?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM episodes WHERE season BETWEEN 4 AND 8 AND air_date >= '2007-01-01'

cases.question: For every season whose largest episode number is at least 12, show the season and that largest episode number. Put the largest values first, then the earlier season first when tied.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT season, MAX(episode_in_season) FROM episodes GROUP BY season HAVING MAX(episode_in_season) >= 12 ORDER BY MAX(episode_in_season) DESC, season ASC

cases.question: From 1998 through 2003, which years had a best home-run performance above 50? Show the year and its best total, strongest first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year, MAX(HR) FROM performances WHERE year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2003 GROUP BY year HAVING MAX(HR) > 50 ORDER BY MAX(HR) DESC

cases.question: Which birth countries produced at least 100 players? Show each country with its player count, from most to least.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT birth_country, COUNT(*) FROM players GROUP BY birth_country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

cases.question: How many players born in the USA after 1970 bat left-handed?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE birth_country = 'USA' AND birth_year > 1970 AND bats = 'L'

cases.question: During 1995 through 2005, what were the seven highest distinct salaries above ten million dollars?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM salaries WHERE year BETWEEN 1995 AND 2005 AND salary > 10000000 ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 7

cases.question: Considering only performances with at least 20 home runs, which five years had the most such performances? Show the year and how many there were.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year, COUNT(*) FROM performances WHERE HR >= 20 GROUP BY year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, year ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Which cities have at least 20 schools? Show each city with its number of schools, most schools first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, city ASC

cases.question: For Boston and Cambridge, break down the number of schools by city and school type.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT city, type, COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE city IN ('Boston', 'Cambridge') GROUP BY city, type ORDER BY city ASC, type ASC

cases.question: How many graduation records have at least a 95 percent graduation rate and no more than a 2 percent dropout rate?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graduation_rates WHERE graduated >= 95 AND dropped <= 2

cases.question: How many districts are there of each type? Only include district types that occur at least 10 times, with the more common type first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) FROM districts GROUP BY type HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

cases.question: Among expenditure records covering at least 5,000 pupils and spending at least $18,000 per pupil, show the ten highest per-pupil expenditures along with pupil counts. Highest spending first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT pupils, per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures WHERE pupils >= 5000 AND per_pupil_expenditure >= 18000 ORDER BY per_pupil_expenditure DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: How many expenditure records cover between 1,000 and 5,000 pupils while spending more than $20,000 per pupil?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expenditures WHERE pupils BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 AND per_pupil_expenditure > 20000
